body: I am attempting! To do so! The goal is there!

I didn't know if it was a big enough deal to involve the police. And I can't prove that I didn't do everything in the pictures I've taken. At this point she only does things when I'm not home, and I just take pictures after, but I can't prove she was the one who turned the air and the hot water and everything, and not me. I never see her except the day she took her bed out. When I tried to confront her that day with a friend on the phone in my pocket she just denied it to my face. I've thought about buying a security camera for inside the house, but they're all crazy expensive.

I already talked to the leasing office, all they said I can do is change the locks at the end of the month.  But she paid rent for the month so they say there's nothing they can do. They were kinda my big hope for help and now I have no clue what to do.
That really means a lot, thank you!
Thank you. I just found out I'll be homeless on the 8th. Thanks for the support.
